notes: Fires to write (Mode A) or run (Mode B) unit tests for a specific module/service/component. Boundary case tests that a cross-component E2E workflow routes to integration-test.

evals.prompt: Write unit tests for the OrderService — cover create, cancel, and make sure soft-deleted orders are excluded from queries.
evals.expected_output: Mode A: detects the backend test framework, reads TEST_VIEWPOINT/CODING_RULES/TECH spec, and creates docs/test-cases/UTC-order.md covering auth 401 / RBAC 403, CRUD happy paths, input-validation 400s, and the soft-delete exclusion — no execution yet.

evals.prompt: Run the unit tests for the auth controller and give me a coverage report.
evals.expected_output: Mode B: greps for the existing docs/test-cases/UTC-auth.md precondition, runs the module's unit suite with coverage using the detected framework, applies the R1-R5 round gates, and writes docs/test-reports/UTR-auth-R[n].md.

evals.prompt: Write E2E tests for the checkout flow across login, cart, and payment.
evals.expected_output: Should route to integration-test, not fire, because this is a multi-component end-to-end workflow — unit-test is NOT FOR integration/E2E tests.
